description:
How are you going to apply these rules of your mind? ✨

Here are the four important things you need to know about the mind:

🧠 Your mind does exactly what it thinks you want it to do, responding to your thoughts and commands.
😥 Your mind is hardwired to move towards pleasure and away from pain, guiding your decisions and actions.
🗣️The way you feel is influenced by the pictures you create in your head and the words you say to yourself, shaping your emotions and outlook.
☺️ Your mind loves what is familiar, gravitating towards known patterns and routines.

Understanding these principles can help you program your mind to work for you and not against you. By being mindful of your thoughts, words, and habits, you can harness the power of your mind to achieve greater well-being and success. 

#MindPower #SelfAwareness #PositiveThinking #MentalHealth #MindHacks #PersonalGrowth #Mindfulness
transcript: What I believe is you need to know four things about your mind. And if you put these four things into practice, you will have success across the board at every level. So let me tell you what these four things are about your mind. Your mind does exactly, specifically what it thinks you want it to do. It always does what it thinks is in your very best interest. If you haven't got what you want, but you've got behaviors you don't want, you are not collaborating properly with your mind. Secondly, your mind is hardwired to move you towards pleasure and away from pain. And that's why it interests from being tribes people. You survive on the planet by avoiding pain. Thirdly, the way you feel about everything all the time is only down to two things, the pictures you make in your head and the words you say to yourself and fourthly your mind loves what is familiar it is programmed to keep going over and over again for what is familiar if you want to succeed at any level you have got to make what is familiar unfamiliar and what is unfamiliar familiar
